78
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, March 16, 2018/Phalguna 25, 1939 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture and Farmers Welfare; Chemicals and Fertilizers;
Coal; Communications; Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution;
Electronics and Information Technology; Food Processing Industries;
Law and Justice; Parliamentary Affairs; Railways)
Total number of questions — 15
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Suicides by farmers
†*226. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the incidents of farmers'
suicides are continuing unabatedly in the
country, including Maharashtra;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) the steps taken by Government to
prevent farmers' suicides;
(d) whether Government has provided
financial assistance/funds to the States for
the solution of farmers' problems;
(e) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
Increasing storage capacity of
godowns in Maharashtra
*227. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
construct new godowns for foodgrains and
other agricultural produces at different
locations in Maharashtra to help farmers
and strengthen Public Distribution System
(PDS) in the State;
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government also proposes
to increase the storage capacity of the
existing godowns in the State; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Reduction in milk procurement prices
*228. SHRI DILIP KUMAR TIRKEY:
Will the Minister of  AGRICULTURE  AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that despite record
milk production, small dairy farmers are
facing hardships because of reduction in milk
procurement prices by some co-operatives
in different parts of the country; and

79
(b) if so, the details thereof and the steps
taken by Government to help small dairy
farmers in the country?
Enquiry into contract for National
Internet Backbone and AMC
*229. SHRI JA VED ALI KHAN: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS be
pleased to refer to answers to Starred
Question 107, Unstarred Question 3424
and Starred Question 138 given in the Rajya
Sabha on 25 November, 2016, 16 December,
2016 and 28 July, 2017 respectively and
state:
(a) whether advice sought from Central
Vigilance Commission (CVC) regarding
` 300 crore scam in BSNL in award of
contract for expansion of  National Internet
Backbone and in annual maintenance
contract (AMC) along with purchase of
new hardware, has been received;
(b) if so, the details thereof along with
the date of receipt and legal/penal action
taken against the culprits; and
(c) if not, the reasons for delay in taking
action against the culprits by Government?
Model railway stations under Ratlam
railway division
†*230. DR. SATY ANARAY AN
JATIYA: Will the Minister of  RAILWAYS
be pleased to state:
(a) the names of the stations which are
to be transformed into Model railway
stations under Ratlam railway division of
Western Railway and the time bound action
plan for providing modern passenger
amenities; and
(b) the details of  the works to be carried
out for renovation and expansion of  Indore,
Ujjain, Nagda, Ratlam, Mandsaur and
Nimach railway stations in the year 2018-
19 with reference to 'a' above?
Execution of railway projects in
Odisha by RVNL
*231. SHRI NARENDRA KUMAR
SWAIN: Will the Minister of  RAILWAYS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Rail Vikas Nigam
Limited (RVNL), which has been entrusted
with the execution of  two railway projects,
i.e., Haridaspur-Paradip and Angul-Sukinda
in Odisha, is unwilling to take up
construction work of these projects due to
conflict of interest; and
(b) by when Railways are going to fix
up a new agency for early completion of
the above projects, which have been
targeted for their completion in March,
2018 and June, 2018, respectively ?
Restructuring the FCI
*232. SHRIMATI RAJANI PATIL:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is planning for
restructuring of  the Food Corporation of
India (FCI);
(b) if so, the details thereof including
the major steps being taken by Government
therefor;
(c) whether Government proposes to
dissolve or dilute the responsibilities of  the
FCI, including that of  procuring foodgrains
from the farmers, if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether Government has received
any complaints regarding the dissolution or
reducing the responsibilities of the FCI; and
(e) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

80
Gramin Dak Sevaks
*233. PROF. M.V . RAJEEV GOWDA:
Will the Minister of COMMUNI-
CATIONS be pleased to state:
(a) the number of new Gramin Dak
Sevaks employed since 2010, year-wise and
State-wise;

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, March 16, 2018/Phalguna 25, 1939 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Agriculture and Farmers Welfare; Chemicals and Fertilizers;
Coal; Communications; Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution;
Electronics and Information Technology; Food Processing Industries;
Law and Justice; Parliamentary Affairs; Railways)
Total number of questions — 160
Efforts to enhance farmers' income
†2401. SHRI AMAR SHANKAR
SABLE: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware of
monthly/annual average income of farmers
during the current year and last three
years;
(b) whether any survey has been
conducted for this, if so, the details threof,
State-wise;
(c) whether any target has been fixed
by Government to enhance the income of
farmers, if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether any efforts have been made
by Government to increase the income of
farmers during the last three years, if so,
the details thereof; and
(d) the extent of increase in the income
of farmers by the efforts made by
Government along with the details
thereof?
Services of Cost Accountants for fixing
MSP
†2402. SHRIMATI CHHAYA
VERMA:
CH. SUKHRAM SINGH
Y ADAV:
SHRI VISHAMBHAR
PRASAD NISHAD:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
AND FARMERS WELFARE be pleased
to state:
(a) the crops produced by the farmers
which have been sold below minimum
support price (MSP) during last three years;
(b) the increase in MSP of the produce
of farmers during last one decade and the
increase in the salary of Government
employees during the same period;
(c) whether Ministry would consider
taking the services of Cost Accountants in
deriving the agro-prices to facilitate
profitable price of the produces of farmers;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

566
Compensation to farmers of J & K
under PMFBY
2403. SHRI SHAMSHER SINGH
MANHAS: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the number of farmers registered
under the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima
Yojana (PMFBY) in Jammu and Kashmir
(J & K) State;
(b) the number of farmers from J & K
who have availed this Yojana, along with
the details thereof, district- wise; and
(c) the total number of insured farmers
who were provided compensation due to
the failure of  wheat & paddy crops in
J & K State?
Issuance of Soil Health Cards to the
farmers of Jammu and Kashmir
2404. SHRI SHAMSHER SINGH
MANHAS: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the number of Soil Health Cards
issued to the farmers so far in Jammu and
Kashmir State; and
(b) the number of farmers who got these
cards in the State along with the details
thereof, district-wise?
Making e-NAM platform more user-
friendly
2405. SHRI MOHD. ALI KHAN: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that several new
features have been added to National
Agriculture Market (e-NAM) platform to
make it more user-friendly, if so, the details
thereof; and
(b) the number of e-NAM centres
presently established and the number of
States covered under this facility?
Road map for doubling of farmers’
income
2406. PROF. M.V . RAJEEV GOWDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the outcomes of  the two-day National
Conference held on February 19-20, 2018
at Pusa to chalk out a road map to achieve
the target of doubling farmers’ income by
2022 along with details thereof;
(b) the proposed time-frame for
implementation of the outcomes;
(c) the details of various stakeholders
who participated in the National Conference;
and
(d) the number of farmers consulted to
develop the road map alongwith details
thereof?
Subsidy for agricultural machinery
2407. DR. PRABHAKAR KORE: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
further increase the subsidy level for the
agricultural machinery;
(b) whether Government is making
efforts to develop simple low-priced agri-
equipments to help small and medium
farmers;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?

567
Damage to crops due to unseasonal
rains and hailstorms
2408. SHRI SANJAY SETH: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether unseasonal rains and
hailstorms have damaged Rabi crops such
as wheat, chana and bajra besides high value
horticulture crops in several parts of the
country including Marathwada and
Vidarbha;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the estimated quantum of crops
affected and damaged and the amount of
loss to farmers;
(d) whether Central Government will
extend compensation to farmers who are
affected by unseasonal showers and
hailstorms;
(e) if so, norms and criteria fixed by
Government for this purpose; and
(f) the other steps taken by Government
